visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dimly lit, cluttered office or studio space packed with stacked cardboard boxes labeled with 'Taiwan' and various logistics stickers. A large flat-screen monitor on a mobile stand displays a live stream where a group of people is sitting on a green artificial turf rug. A camera on a tripod and a professional studio light are visible. (2) The camera moves dynamically through the room, revealing real people sitting on a green rug in the office, mirroring the screen. They are dressed casually in t-shirts and tank tops; several people hold smartphones and small microphones. Boxes of pizza and bottles of soda are scattered on the floor near them. (3) The camera focuses back on the monitor screen which shows a numerical subscriber count rapidly ticking upward, currently near 999,985. The people in the room are pointing at the screen, cheering with wide smiles and raised hands. (4) Close-up shots of individual faces show high arousal; a man in a white t-shirt laughs with his head back, and a woman with glasses and a beige shirt shouts towards the camera. The subscriber count on the screen hits 1,000,000, and the group erupts into a frenzy of jumping and arm-waving. (5) The final shots show a woman holding her phone close to her face, smiling broadly as she speaks, followed by various group members shouting and gesturing 'peace' signs towards the camera in a celebratory manner against the backdrop of the office and grey curtains.
